description: This file defines the AccessManager class in Drupal, responsible for attaching and executing access check services on routes and requests.

classes.name: AccessManager
classes.description: Manages access checks for routes and requests within Drupal, attaching services and executing them to determine access permissions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes dependencies such as route provider, param converter, arguments resolver factory, current user, and check provider.

methods.name: checkNamedRoute
methods.description: Checks access for a route specified by name with given parameters and optional account, returning a boolean or object.

methods.name: checkRequest
methods.description: Checks access based on an HTTP request, optionally for a specific user account.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Performs access checks on a route match object, considering checks that require the request and user account.

methods.name: performCheck
methods.description: Executes a specific access check service with resolved arguments, ensuring it returns a valid AccessResultInterface.
